review_candidates.title: Systems Analyst – Platform Implementation & Integration
review_candidates.description: ESF is seeking a talented and motivated Systems Analyst to join our core team as we drive our ambitious Digital Modernization initiative. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in implementing, configuring, and supporting core enterprise platforms (including Toddle and Sentral) across our 24 schools. Working collaboratively with school leadership, vendors, and central teams, you will help streamline platform workflows, resolve technical integration challenges, and consolidate system enhancements into clear operational roadmaps. Key Responsibilities Lead functional configuration, system updates, and workflow setups for SaaS educational platforms, ensuring alignment with school operations. Partner with external vendors and internal technical teams to diagnose root causes, manage system patches, and resolve integration issues between enterprise systems. Consolidate, evaluate, and prioritize change requests and technical enhancements across multiple school feedback streams into a single structured master backlog. Collaborate directly with Vice Principals, Change Champions, and school administrators across 24 schools to gather requirements, run UAT, and support training initiatives. Technical Competencies Required At least 4 years of SQL programming experience with a preference for SQL Server and/or Oracle. At least 5 years of web application development experience in PHP Designing & building backend APIs and middleware architectures Proficiency in front-end frameworks (such as React, Angular, or Vue.js) is a strong advantage At least two years of experience providing IT application support to end customers Technical & Professional Experience Proven experience as a Systems Analyst or Business Analyst managing large-scale application rollouts, SaaS implementations, and complex enhancement backlogs. Hands-on experience configuring, testing, and troubleshooting cross-system integrations using REST and SOAP APIs, as well as managing vendor patches and fixes. Strong analytical abilities with a track record of translating complex school/business requirements into clear technical specifications and action plans. Core Competencies & Personal Attributes Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a collaborative, customer-centric approach to supporting non-technical stakeholders and school staff. A self-starter who takes initiative to identify operational needs and deliver quality results independently without needing prompt supervision. Excellent time management and prioritization skills, with the flexibility to adapt smoothly to shifting project needs and tight deadlines. Typical reporting relationship : Learning Management Systems Manager Minimum typical education: University degree in Computer Science or related disciplines Minimum typical experience : 7 to 10 years of IT application development and support experience. Applicants must be a permanent Hong Kong resident or possess a valid visa to work in Hong Kong. For enquiries, please contact Karen Ng @ 37622653 or Email: Karen.ng@esfcentre.edu.hk Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis and offers may be extended prior to the job closing date. We strongly recommend early applications as we reserve the right to appoint candidates earlier than the closing date. By applying for this position, your application may be considered for other opportunities (senior-level roles, head of department, etc.) within ESF. ESF is an Equal Opportunities Employer The English Schools Foundation (ESF) is fully committed to providing equal employment opportunities. ESF will not discriminate on the basis of age, race, colour, gender, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, national origin, religion, veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, creed, citizenship or any other status protected by local laws or regulations. Personal data provided by job applicants will be used strictly in accordance with the ESF's Personal Data Policy, a copy of which will be provided upon request. ESF is dedicated to ensuring the safety and well-being of all students in our care and expects all applicants to uphold this commitment. We adhere to rigorous recruitment practices, with all appointments contingent upon an interview, identity verification, criminal background checks (including ICPC, SCRC, and other international background checks as appropriate), assessment of social media presence, and positive references. In accordance with the Keeping Children Safe in Education (KCSIE) 2025 guidelines, ESF may perform online checks for all shortlisted candidates prior to the interview. About Us The English Schools Foundation (ESF) is the largest English-medium international school organisation in Hong Kong. Our 22 schools and comprehensive programme of extra-curricular activities bring out the best in every student through a personalised approach to learning and by inspiring curious minds. There are over 18,000 students from 75 different nationalities in ESF kindergartens, primary, secondary and all-through schools. www.esf.edu.hk About The Team The English Schools Foundation (ESF) is a modern, well-managed educational organisation, committed to offering an international education to students drawn from over 70 countries. We are proud to be at the forefront of the educational hub in Hong Kong. We actively take advantage of the opportunities that Hong Kong offers as Asia’s world city and the principal gate-way to China. The curriculum, leading to the International Baccalaureate, is adapted to Hong Kong, and the Asia Pacific region. ESF’s 1,100 teachers are highly qualified bringing with them experience from Australia, Canada, New Zealand, the United States, the UK and many other international school systems. All schools offer a broad range of out-of-school activities in Hong Kong and overseas. ESF has over 18,000 students. Our culture is one of joy in learning and pride in achievement. The great majority of our students study for the IB Diploma and gain entry to universities all over the world. ESF has a long-standing commitment to children with individual needs and is the principal provider for English-speaking children with special educational needs in Hong Kong. For further details about ESF, please visit our website at https://www.esf.edu.hk/.

review_candidates.title: Sr Director IT Business Partner
review_candidates.description: Job Description The Senior Director – IT Business Partner for India, Middle East, & Rest of Asia is a strategic leadership role responsible for partnering closely with the Building Automation leadership teams across India, Middle East, and Rest of Asia to enable business outcomes through technology, digital innovation, and operational excellence. This role serves as the primary IT interface for the regional organization, ensuring strong alignment between regional business priorities, Honeywell Global Digital & IT (GDM), and the Building Automation IT strategy. The role requires a leader who can operate effectively in a high-growth, highly diverse regional landscape, while building a strong, scalable, and future-ready IT organization. Responsibilities Key Responsibilities Strategic Business Partnership Act as a trusted technology and digital advisor to BA regional leadership across India, Middle East, and Rest of Asia. Translate regional BA growth, customer, and operational strategies into clear IT demand, roadmaps, and investment priorities. Shape and influence business decisions by providing technology insights, trade-off analysis, and risk perspectives. Drive technology enablement for regional growth, localization needs, regulatory requirements, and customer experience. IT Strategy Alignment & Delivery Ensure strong alignment of regional IT priorities with global BA IT and GDM strategies, standards, and architecture. Lead execution of enterprise and BA-specific IT initiatives, including ERP, digital platforms, analytics, cloud, cybersecurity, and OT/IT integration. Balance regional responsiveness with global standardization, ensuring scalable and compliant solutions. Partner with GDM, COEs, and global IT teams to prioritize initiatives, manage dependencies, and ensure delivery discipline. People Leadership & Organization Building Build, lead, and continuously strengthen a high-performing IT organization across the regions, including India and Middle East hubs. Provide direct people leadership with accountability for talent acquisition, performance management, succession planning, and leadership development. Develop strong regional IT leadership bench strength, coaching senior leaders and high-potential talent. Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, inclusion, innovation, and continuous improvement. Governance, Stakeholder & Financial Management Establish and operate effective IT governance, demand management, and investment review mechanisms across the region. Ensure disciplined budget management, cost optimization, and vendor performance management. Drive transparency in IT performance, value realization, and risk management with regional and global stakeholders. Operational Excellence, Risk & Compliance Ensure reliable, secure, and resilient IT services supporting BA sales, services, engineering, and operations across the regions. Champion cybersecurity, data privacy, and regulatory compliance, including region-specific requirements. Proactively manage operational, delivery, and third-party risks in a complex multi-country environment. Critical Competencies & Capabilities Strategic IT Business Partnership – Ability to align IT strategy with diverse regional business needs and influence senior leaders. People Leadership & Organization Building – Proven success in building, scaling, and leading geographically distributed, multicultural teams. Global–Regional Matrix Leadership – Effectively navigate global standards while addressing regional growth and localization needs. Digital & Enterprise Transformation Leadership – Experience leading large-scale transformation programs in growth markets. Executive Presence & Communication – Strong ability to engage, influence, and communicate with senior stakeholders across cultures. Change & Complexity Leadership – Lead through ambiguity, rapid growth, and regulatory diversity. Qualifications Qualifications & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline; Master’s degree preferred. 15+ years of progressive IT leadership experience, including senior roles as an IT Business Partner or equivalent. Strong experience working with senior business leaders in global or regional roles, preferably in high-growth markets. Solid background in enterprise applications, digital platforms, cybersecurity, and IT governance. Demonstrated people management experience, including leading leaders and building regional organizations. Experience in Building Automation, Industrial, Smart Buildings, or B2B technology environments strongly preferred. About Us Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

review_candidates.description: The Senior Systems Analyst is responsible for analyzing business and operational requirements across Ports & Terminals and translating them into effective IT solutions. The role works closely with Operations, business stakeholders, vendors, and internal IT teams to enhance existing applications, introduce automation, and ensure systems remain reliable, scalable, and aligned with operational requirements. The position performs functional and technical analysis, prepares solution designs and specifications, conducts impact assessments, and supports the complete solution lifecycle from requirements gathering through development, testing, implementation, and post-go-live support. The role also ensures seamless integration between Terminal Operating Systems, gate systems, equipment systems, automation platforms, and other third-party applications. The Senior Systems Analyst provides application support, performs root-cause analysis for incidents, monitors system performance and interfaces, and identifies opportunities to improve productivity and operational efficiency. The role also supports project delivery, vendor coordination, testing, documentation, and knowledge transfer while ensuring compliance with IT governance, cybersecurity, and information-security standards. Key Responsibilities Based on the demand, feasibility, capex and requirements provided by Manager prepare the High-Level Design / Architecture. Get the Design approved from review team. Draw up the plan and coordinate to complete Technical Specifications Documents Identify various modules to be developed and indicate the major data flows within the application and interface to other applications. Ensure that IT Standards (such as policy, framework, procedures and protocol) are followed to design the applications therefore it’s scalable, reliable, extensible & performance oriented Guide System Analysts in creating Software Requirements Specification from Business Requirements Specification thereby achieving high standard of quality. Mentor/Guide System Analyst during application design and ensure that outcome of design encapsulate the entire business requirements Ensure IT Security components are adequately enabled throughout the SDLC Publish a standard operating procedure on how database for an application is to be designed and how data values are to be fetched from the database with optimum efficiency. Review this architecture in the light of retiring old applications and development of new applications to meet business needs. Introduce programming techniques and development tool to reduce software development time. To keep abreast of business trends in the respective domain and thereby aiding the IT Department craft better IT solutions for the business. To verify QA test result thereby confirming compliance of developed software to SRS Ensure compliance to IT policy in terms of implementation and monitoring of information security management in your department in line with the UAE region ISR policy. Qualifications, Experience & Skills Essential Qualification: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Desirable Qualification: Master’s degree in Business Administration (MBA) or Information Systems Work Experience: Minimum 6 years experience in SDLC applied to software development projects, SQERT based project Analysis, Project management tools, Resource management methodology and tools, Software development experience in coding computer programs is preferred.
